2609.03588.title: KC-Bench: A Dynamic Interactive Benchmark for Evaluating Knowledge Conflicts in LLM Agents
2609.03588.paper_summary: As LLMs increasingly act through tools, they must reconcile user instructions, parametric knowledge, and dynamic environmental observations before taking actions. We introduce KC-Bench, a controlled multi-turn benchmark for measuring this capability across world-knowledge conflicts, input inconsistencies, and multi-source temporal conflicts. Its 238 tasks are manually screened from more than 1,000 generated candidates and combine a user simulator, stateful tools, deterministic environment assertions, an open-source natural-language evaluator, and human trajectory verification. Evaluation of nine models, including DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3, shows substantial cross-domain variation: no model handles factual correction, identity consistency checking, and temporal conflict resolution reliably across all settings. In the simulated environments, missed conflicts can propagate to tool calls or synthetic protected-data flows. KC-Bench isolates this model-level behavior rather than ranking complete agent frameworks, and provides a reproducible diagnostic for developing conflict-aware reasoning and execution safeguards.
2609.03588.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地通過工具進行操作，它們必須在採取行動之前調和用戶指令、參數知識和動態環境觀察。我們介紹 KC-Bench，一個受控的多輪基準，用於測量這種能力，涵蓋世界知識衝突、輸入不一致性和多來源時間衝突。其238個任務是從超過1,000個生成的候選項中手動篩選出來的，並結合了用戶模擬器、有狀態的工具、確定性環境斷言、開源自然語言評估器和人類軌跡驗證。對九個模型的評估，包括 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2 和 MiniMax-M3，顯示出顯著的跨領域變異：沒有一個模型能在所有設置中可靠地處理事實修正、身份一致性檢查和時間衝突解決。在模擬環境中，錯過的衝突可能會傳播到工具調用或合成的受保護數據流。KC-Bench 隔離了這種模型級行為，而不是對完整的代理框架進行排名，並提供了一個可重現的診斷工具，用於開發衝突感知的推理和執行保障。
